narration: The multimodal pipeline begins with an input image containing detected bounding boxes for candidate entities, alongside a textual query describing a woman carrying a hat and holding a beverage.
The textual query is parsed into a structured language graph, identifying the subject entity woman connected via relations carry and hold to the object entities hat and beverage.
In the message propagation module, entity nodes and relational affinities are initialized by grounding language elements to visual bounding box features and spatial candidate matrices.
Next, bottom-up and top-down belief propagation iteratively aggregates and updates messages between entity nodes using belief selection and gating units.
Finally, the readout head processes the updated graph marginals to produce image-text matching predictions and relational difference representations for multihop reasoning.
